page: Microsoft Azure ND128isr_NDR_GB200_v6 is an isolated, GPU-accelerated instance designed for large-scale artificial intelligence, foundation model training, and high-performance computing workloads. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the platform provides 128 dedicated vCPUs built on an arm64 architecture alongside 864 GB of total system RAM, corresponding to approximately 6.75 GB of memory per core.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by four NVIDIA Blackwell GB200 GPUs delivering an aggregate 768 GB of high-bandwidth GPU memory (VRAM). To handle extensive data streaming and rapid model checkpointing, the instance integrates 16,459 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Inter-node scalability is supported via RDMA networking capabilities, enabling low-latency, high-throughput fabrics essential for multi-node distributed training clusters.

By coupling dense GPU memory with substantial local NVMe storage, this configuration reduces I/O wait times during large dataset ingest and complex checkpoint sequences. Resource tradeoffs include the arm64 instruction set, which necessitates compatible binary software stacks, and the absence of complimentary public IPv4 addressing. The instance is suited for large language model pre-training, massive distributed deep learning, and advanced AI research simulations.
description: Microsoft Azure ND128isr_NDR_GB200_v6 is a dedicated GPU-accelerated instance designed for massive artificial intelligence and deep learning workloads. Running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 128 dedicated vCPUs on an arm64 architecture, paired with 864 GB of system memory at 6.75 GB per core. Accelerator capability is driven by four NVIDIA Blackwell GB200 GPUs providing a combined 768 GB of VRAM, targeted at high-parameter model execution. For high-throughput local operations and checkpoint retention, the instance features 16,459 GB of bundled NVMe SSD storage. Built-in RDMA support facilitates efficient multi-node scaling across distributed compute fabrics without standard network bottlenecks. With isolated physical tenancy and high memory density across both host and accelerator domains, this server is specifically optimized for large language model training, foundation model fine-tuning, and high-throughput computational AI pipelines.
